business_summary: Dong Sung Bio Pharm.Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and cosmetics in South Korea. The company offers over the counter drugs, such as emollient, vitamin supplement, alopecia treatment, antihistamines, liver disease treatment, fire extinguisher solvent, antiviral, eye drops, menopause treatment, sleep inducer, antipyretic, analgesic, anti-inflammatory, vascular reinforcement, broad-spectrum skin disease treatment, gum disease treatment, blood circulation improver, scar treatment, dry stomach, eye nourishment, abdominal obesity treatment, anti-soil agent, respiratory solvent, and antifungal agent. It also provides prescription drugs, including endocrine system, corticosteroids, fire extinguishing system, circulatory system, psychotropic solvents, tumor therapy, analgesic anti-inflammatory, cutaneous urinary system, antiviral, antibiotics, and respiratory system. In addition, the company offers hair dye, cosmetics, health functional supplements, nasal spray, household goods, muscle taping, disinfectant, toothpaste, anti-hair loss shampoo, and sanitary napkin. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 동성바이오팜(주) 한국에서 의약품과 화장품을 제조 및 판매하는 회사입니다. 피부연화제, 비타민보충제, 탈모증치료제, 항히스타민제, 간질환치료제, 소화용제, 항바이러스제, 점안제, 갱년기치료제, 수면유도제, 해열제, 진통제, 항염증제, 혈관강화제, 광범위 피부질환치료제, 잇몸질환치료제, 혈액순환개선제, 흉터치료제, 위건조치료제, 눈자양제, 복부비만치료제, 항토양제, 호흡기용제, 항진균제. 또한 내분비계통, 코르티코스테로이드, 소화계통, 순환계통, 향정신성 용매, 종양치료제, 진통제 항염증제, 피부 비뇨기계통, 항바이러스제, 항생제, 호흡기계통 등의 처방약도 제공합니다. 이 밖에도 염모제, 화장품, 건강기능식품, 비강 스프레이, 생활용품, 근육 테이핑, 소독제, 치약, 탈모방지 샴푸, 생리대 등도 판매하고 있다. 이 회사는 1957년에 설립되었으며 본사는 대한민국 서울에 있습니다.
